decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed installation of a vehicular crossover to part of the premises will not be detrimental the existing dwellinghouse or have any associated negative impacts on the adjoining dwellings or surrounding area. The proposal has been designed in accordance with the provisions of Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and Section 11 of the Unitary Development Plan - Supplementary Planning Guidance (1997).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority a plan indicating the reinstatement of a front boundary wall.
description: Construction of vehicle crossover to front of premises.
